claims.atomic_claim: The latest Nightfall release tag is visible and can be resolved locally.
claims.limitation: Tag resolution does not prove binary provenance.

claims.atomic_claim: A release workflow exists at the release tag.
claims.limitation: Workflow presence does not prove that every release asset was produced by that workflow.

claims.atomic_claim: Release assets have workflow surface explanations by filename category.
claims.limitation: Filename/workflow surface matching is heuristic and not source-to-binary proof.
Requires reproducible build process or stronger provenance evidence.
Requires deterministic build recipe, pinned toolchains and byte-level comparison.

claims.observed_evidence: not proven by workflow, tag or checksum evidence
claims.limitation: Binary safety cannot be inferred from release workflow surface evidence.
